purpose: Read-only MCP Perfetto comparison requested by the user: historical baseline rank0 update11, fresh baseline rank0 update21, V2 rank0 update21.

method.import: Existing monitorfree-perfetto-prepare.py preserves all device events via display lanes; GPU user projections excluded. Canonical inputs unchanged.
method.scope: Rank0 input phase plus exactly first three complete forward/backward microbatches.
method.gpu_tail: End is max GPU completion among device events linked to host launch APIs before CPU microbatch3 return. All device events have host launch flow linkage.
method.busy: Interval unions across local device streams. Communication includes peer/spin waiting and is not useful compute.
method.classification: NCCL; HybridEP/explicit DeepEP families; copy; memset; remaining kernels. Remaining kernels may include unclassified waits.
limits: No worker stacks or complete preceding producer activity.
No remaining29 microbatches, optimizer, full-step runtime or memory inference from V2 trace.
Historical update11 and new update21 use different epoch length/input position and profiling duration; fresh matched baseline controls attribution.
Host API duration includes waiting and scheduling, not CPU utilization.
Single traces cannot establish noise, general speedup or absence of all regressions.

CREATE PERFETTO TABLE analysis_link AS
 SELECT d.*,h.id host_id,h.ts host_ts,h.dur host_dur,h.name host_name,h.tid host_tid
 FROM analysis_device d JOIN flow f ON f.slice_in=d.id JOIN thread_slice h ON h.id=f.slice_out
 WHERE h.category IN ('cuda_runtime','cuda_driver');
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM analysis_device) device_events,(SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM analysis_link) linked_events,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stats WHERE severity='error' AND value>0) importer_errors,
 (SELECT round((max(ts+dur)-(SELECT lo FROM analysis_windows WHERE win='three_fb'))/1e6,6) FROM analysis_link WHERE host_ts<(SELECT hi FROM analysis_windows WHERE win='three_fb') AND host_ts>=(SELECT lo FROM analysis_windows WHERE win='three_fb')) full_three_device_span_ms,
 (SELECT round((max(ts+dur)-(SELECT hi FROM analysis_windows WHERE win='three_fb'))/1e6,6) FROM analysis_link WHERE host_ts<(SELECT hi FROM analysis_windows WHERE win='three_fb') AND host_ts>=(SELECT lo FROM analysis_windows WHERE win='three_fb')) tail_after_cpu_ms;

CREATE PERFETTO TABLE analysis_host_intervals AS
WITH clipped AS (
SELECT s.id,CASE WHEN s.name GLOB '*Synchronize*' THEN 'sync' ELSE 'launch' END family,MAX(s.ts,w.lo) b,MIN(s.ts+s.dur,w.hi) e
FROM thread_slice s JOIN analysis_full_window w ON s.ts<w.hi AND s.ts+s.dur>w.lo
WHERE s.category IN ('cuda_runtime','cuda_driver') AND (s.name GLOB '*Synchronize*' OR s.name GLOB '*Launch*')),
prev AS (SELECT *,MAX(e) OVER(PARTITION BY family ORDER BY b,e,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) previous_end FROM clipped),
numbered AS (SELECT *,SUM(CASE WHEN b>coalesce(previous_end,b-1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY family ORDER BY b,e,id) grp FROM prev)
SELECT family,grp,min(b) b,max(e) e FROM numbered GROUP BY family,grp;
WITH gaps AS (SELECT prev_end b,b e FROM analysis_full_gaps UNION ALL SELECT lo,(SELECT min(b) FROM analysis_full_device) FROM analysis_full_window),
overlap AS (SELECT h.family,sum(MIN(h.e,g.e)-MAX(h.b,g.b))/1e6 idle_ms FROM analysis_host_intervals h JOIN gaps g ON h.b<g.e AND h.e>g.b GROUP BY h.family)
SELECT h.family,round(sum(h.e-h.b)/1e6,3) union_ms,round(coalesce(o.idle_ms,0),3) overlap_recorded_gpu_idle_ms
FROM analysis_host_intervals h LEFT JOIN overlap o ON o.family=h.family GROUP BY h.family;
